item.title: github: Search and filter for budgets now available
item.description:
GitHub Billing’s “Budgets and alerts” page now lists all budgets in one place and adds search and filter capabilities. This makes it easier to find specific budgets in accounts with multiple entries.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Set an expiration date for individual user budgets
item.description:
GitHub now lets you set an optional expiration date on an individual user budget. When the date is reached, GitHub automatically removes the budget; the feature is generally available.

  • Source: GitHub
